title: Select visible presentation text and resolve Diderot-first
purpose: Demonstrate that an arbitrary visible text selection is interpreted as a semantic query, resolved against the bounded Diderot knowledge tier before any internet fallback, rendered interactively, and retained as correlated engineering evidence.
preconditions: The bounded Diderot projection contains the PCA concept.
E2E evidence mode is enabled for the qualification run only.

messages.label: Select text PCA
messages.expected: Selection text is captured as PCA on the mission slide.

messages.label: POST selection + context
messages.expected: HTTP response is resolved, not an invented answer or silent fallback.

messages.label: Resolve PCA locally first
messages.expected: semantic.id = concept:pca, source.tier = diderot, fallback.required = false.

messages.label: Return PCA intuition
messages.expected: Interactive panel title is PCA and explanation states unsupervised linear projection.

messages.label: Emit semantic + explanation signals
messages.expected: Semantic and explanation spans/logs/metric exemplars preserve root TraceId/SpanId correlation.

messages.label: OTLP traces / logs / metrics
messages.expected: GET root SpanId recovers the complete expected subtree and validator returns PASS.

steps.title: Select PCA directly from the visible presentation surface
steps.action: Select the visible text PCA without using the dedicated concept-click behavior.
expected: The source pill identifies Diderot and API transport.
The displayed intuition includes unsupervised linear projection.
No internet fallback link is shown.

steps.title: Verify the semantic API contract
steps.action: Call POST /api/semantic/v1/resolve with PCA and its Study 0 context.

steps.title: Recover and verify semantic runtime evidence
steps.action: Flush OTLP signals and query the evidence bundle by the Playwright root SpanId.
expected: The semantic.resolve span carries selection text PCA and resolver source diderot.
The explanation.render span is correlated to concept:pca.
Expected structured logs and metric exemplars are correlated to their spans.
The executable telemetry contract verdict is PASS.
